name: lift'
statement: M →ₗ[R] M'') (h : ∀ x : S, IsUnit (algebraMap R (Module.End R M'') x)) : LocalizedModule S M → M''

name: IsLocalizedModule.of_restrictScalars
statement: Submonoid R) {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Module A M] [Module A N] [IsScalarTower R A M] [IsScalarTower R A N] (f : M →ₗ[A] N) [IsLocalizedModule S (f.restrictScalars R)] : IsLocalizedModule (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid A S) f where map_units x

name: IsLocalizedModule.of_exists_mul_mem
statement: Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (S T : Submonoid R) (h : S ≤ T) (h' : ∀ x : T, ∃ m : R, m * x ∈ S) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule S f] : IsLocalizedModule T f where map_units x

name: isRegular_of_smul_left_injective
statement: M'} (inj : Function.Injective fun r : R ↦ r • m) (s : S) : IsRegular (s : R)

name: map_LocalizedModules
statement: M₀ →ₗ[R] M₁) (m : M₀) (s : S) : ((map S (mkLinearMap S M₀) (mkLinearMap S M₁)) g) (LocalizedModule.mk m s) = LocalizedModule.mk (g m) s
